Nemunas Cargo Services UAB

Nemunas Cargo Services UAB is a cargo general sales and service agent (GSSA) based at Kaunas Airport (KUN), part of Baltic Example Logistics Group. (Invented company: test fixture.)

We provide cargo sales, reservations and road feeder services for the airlines we represent, with offices in Kaunas, Lithuania and Riga, Latvia, serving Kaunas Airport (KUN) and Vilnius Airport (VNO).
